name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.trapdoorLaw_tail
title: Tail bound for Def_SuccinctLWE's T: all columns shorter than sigma sqrt(lm+m)
statement: If dualMassE([I_l (x) B | W], sigma) <= 1/2 and sigma > 0, then T <- trapdoorLaw p B W is some T' with a column of Euclidean norm >= sigma sqrt(lm + m) with probability at most lnk * 3 * 2^{-(lm+m)}.
